item.title: Global Market: Eurozone bond yields fall as tech sell-off fuels safe-haven demand
item.description: Eurozone government bond yields fell as investors sought safe-haven assets amid a global technology stock sell-off and declining US Treasury yields. Meanwhile, money markets priced in higher European Central Bank rates over the longer term, while French-German and Italian-German bond spreads reflected ongoing market pressures.

item.title: Sebi preparing fresh round of reforms in IPO market, short-selling rules: Chairman
item.description: Sebi is planning comprehensive reforms covering IPO disclosures, SME listings, corporate bond trading, and short-selling rules to ease compliance and safeguard investors. Speaking in Mumbai, Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey also outlined key initiatives, including Demat 2.0 for tokenised bonds, an AI sandbox, and streamlined onboarding for foreign portfolio investors.

item.title: US labour market remains stuck in low-hire, low-fire state as inflation intensifies: Fed
item.description: The Federal Reserve's latest Beige Book highlights persistent inflation pressures and a stagnant US labour market, with rising energy, tariff, and insurance costs hitting businesses. With September consumer inflation rising 3.7%, expectations are growing for another potential interest rate hike at the Fed's upcoming October meeting.
